# Test Plan — AA-1: User Authentication & Account Management

**Generated by:** Test Plan Agent (Stage 2)
**Date:** 2026-08-07
**Source:** docs/epics/requirements_AA-1.md (Stage 1 output)

## 1. Scope

**Features included:**
- AA-10 — Registration (`/auth/register`)
- AA-11 — Login with valid credentials (`/auth/login`)
- AA-12 — Login fails with invalid credentials (`/auth/login`)
- AA-13 — Logout (account dropdown → Sign out)
- AA-14 — Update profile information — **profile-fields form only**
  (`[data-test="update-profile-submit"]`)

**Features explicitly out of scope (and why):**
- "Sign in with Google" OAuth button on `/auth/login` — third-party flow, no Jira story
- 2FA/TOTP setup on `/account/profile` — fires automatically but has no AA-1 AC coverage; test design must not accidentally trigger it
- Password-change sub-form on `/account/profile` (`[data-test="change-password-submit"]`) — not mentioned in AA-14's ACs at all (see requirements doc Ambiguity #4); excluded pending a product-owner scope decision, not a technical limitation
- `/auth/forgot-password` and `/account/messages` — live pages with no corresponding Jira story anywhere in project AA (requirements doc Ambiguities #5)

See `docs/master/test_plan_MASTER.md` §Project-wide Test Strategy for the overall auth/data/CI approach — not repeated here.

## 2. Test Objectives

- Validate the full customer auth lifecycle: register → login (valid/invalid) → logout → profile update
- Produce a reliable authenticated `storageState` fixture — AA-1 is the dependency root for all 8 remaining epics, so a broken session mechanism here blocks the entire suite. This is the single highest-leverage quality risk in this epic.
- Confirm no user-enumeration vector in the login error path (AA-12 AC2 is security-relevant, not just UX)
- Capture the undocumented server-side password-breach rule as first-class negative coverage (not in any Jira AC, found via live verification)

## 3. Test Strategy (epic-specific)

| Story | Layer | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| AA-10 Register | Cross-layer | UI form submission plus `POST /users/register` assertion (201, no auto-login token) — AC3's redirect-vs-auto-login ambiguity is resolved by asserting the API contract directly, not just the resulting page |
| AA-11 Login (valid) | Cross-layer | UI login plus `POST /users/login` → `GET /users/me` assertion; session-persistence AC must be tested via a **real page reload**, not just in-SPA navigation (requirements doc Edge Case #6) |
| AA-12 Login (invalid) | Cross-layer | Wrong-password and non-existent-email cases must be diffed byte-for-byte at both the UI (displayed text) and API (status/body) layers — a UI-only check could hide a backend enumeration leak |
| AA-13 Logout | UI | No logout API endpoint exists (confirmed live) — logout is client-side token clearing only, so this is a UI-layer test; the "protected page redirect" assertion follows actual observed behavior (see Ambiguity #1 below), not the Jira AC text as written |
| AA-14 Update profile | UI | Profile-fields form only; asserts pre-fill (AC1), save (AC2), and field-level email validation (AC3) |

**Epic-specific data setup:** No seed/admin API for user creation was observed — registration (AA-10) is itself the data-seeding mechanism for every other story in this epic. All emails use the `test_{timestamp}@qa.io` dynamic pattern to avoid collisions in the shared demo store (see master risk register).

## 4. Test Environments

- UI pages: `/auth/register`, `/auth/login`, `/account`, `/account/profile`
- API endpoints: `POST /users/register`, `POST /users/login`, `GET /users/me`, `GET /users/refresh`
- No epic-specific credentials required beyond a freshly self-registered user (created by AA-10's own tests)
- No dependency on other epics' test data — AA-1 is first in sequence

## 5. Entry Criteria

- No previous epic (AA-1 is 1st of 9) — no upstream merge dependency
- No `storageState` dependency — this epic **produces** it
- `docs/epics/requirements_AA-1.md` (Stage 1) complete; open ambiguities are documented and non-blocking for entry, but three must be resolved before Stage 6 locks the fixture design (see Risk Register below)

## 6. Exit Criteria

- `@smoke` pass rate: 100%
- `@regression` pass rate: ≥ 95%
- Story coverage: 100% (5/5 stories have ≥ 1 automated test)
- Allure report generated
- Zero P1/P2 open defects linked to AA-1
- **Epic-specific:** the `storageState` fixture is verified functional and consumable before AA-1 is considered mergeable — AA-2 through AA-9 cannot start their own pipelines until this is true

## 7. Risk Register (epic-specific)

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Token storage mechanism (cookie vs. header vs. memory) unconfirmed | High | High | Inspect via devtools/network before Stage 6 designs the `storageState` fixture — every downstream epic depends on getting this right the first time |
| `GET /users/refresh` returns 500 immediately post-logout | Medium | Medium | Reproduce reliably in Stage 8/9; classify as Category C (app bug → file Jira ticket) vs. Category D (flaky) before deciding on `@known-bug`/`@flaky` tagging |
| AA-13 AC2 ("protected pages redirect to login") does not reproduce live — `/account` renders silently instead | Medium | High | Needs a PO/security decision before Stage 3/4 finalizes the negative scenario — could mask a real missing auth-guard, not just a doc error |
| Undocumented server-side password-breach rule (422 on breached password) | Low | Medium | Must be written as its own negative test case in Stage 4 — omitting it leaves a real validation path uncovered |

See `docs/master/test_plan_MASTER.md` §Project-wide Risk Register for shared demo-store/Cloudflare/network risks — not repeated here.

## 8. Test Types In Scope

Functional | Negative | Boundary (password composition rules) | Cross-layer | Accessibility (deferred to Release workflow, owned by Accessibility Reviewer per Section C) — **not** Visual regression (no visually-critical UI surface in this epic).

## 9. Defect Management

- Failures trace back to Jira stories via TC ID (`AA-1-TC-{story#}-{scenario#}`)
- Severity classification for this epic:
  - **P1** — register/login broken (blocks every downstream epic's `storageState`)
  - **P2** — logout or profile-update broken
  - **P3** — cosmetic/text mismatches in validation messages
- Category C findings (e.g. `/users/refresh` 500) are filed as Jira bugs by the Test Healer Agent, tagged `@known-bug`, and do **not** block this epic's exit criteria once triaged

## 10. Schedule

- `@smoke` target: < 5 min (5 stories × 1–2 smoke scenarios ≈ 8–10 scenarios)
- `@regression` target: < 15 min (small epic, pro-rated from the 30 min/epic CI budget)
- Nightly pipeline position: **1st of 9** — runs first since AA-2 through AA-9 all consume its `storageState` output
